title: Instinct of Survival
summary: Untrained and facing a 15-foot Greater Shadow Hound, Ha-Jun relies purely on sovereign survival instincts. Using the Sovereign Domain to slow the beast and awakening the Sovereign Blood Claws, he splits the monster's Void Cannon and obliterates it to protect the university.

panels.action: The Greater Shadow Hound bears its massive weight down onto Ha-Jun's gauntlet; cobblestones crumble beneath his boots.
Ha-Jun's sneakers dig deep trenches into the stone plaza, friction sparks flying as he grits his teeth in defiance.
Kuro's telepathic shout echoes: 'Ladke! Tum koi pehelwan nahi ho! Domain ka istemal karo aur daayre ko dhabao!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Domain use karo! Uske wazan se lado mat!

panels.action: Ha-Jun's eyes flash with electric violet light: 'Domain... ACTIVATE!'
A 5-meter transparent violet sphere expands instantly from Ha-Jun's core, swallowing the hound's front legs and maw.
Inside the domain, the beast's movements slow to a crawl, trapped in dense sovereign gravity like insects in amber.

dialogue.speaker: shadow_hound
dialogue.text: Y-Yeh hawa itni bhaari kyun ho gayi...?!

panels.action: Ha-Jun smoothly slips to the left, slipping out from under the beast's downward trajectory with effortless grace.
The beast's massive claw slams into empty cobblestones, blasting an empty crater into the pavement.
Ha-Jun sprints around to the monster's exposed rib flank, his gauntlet humming with jagged violet lightning arcs.
Ha-Jun's gauntlet fingers flex: Three 2-foot long razor-sharp violet mana blades ignite from his knuckles like energy claws.
A floating violet system prompt: [SKILL AWAKENED: SOVEREIGN BLOOD CLAWS (RANK F)].
Ha-Jun slashes his blood claws diagonally upward into the beast's thick obsidian rib armor with all his strength.
The violet claws slice through the hardened demonic armor like parchment, spraying black ichor and bone fragments into the rain.
In berserk pain, the Shadow Hound whips its massive spiked tail horizontally like a battering ram.
Ha-Jun blocks with his gauntlet, but the tail's concussive force catches his side, sending him skidding 20 feet across the plaza.
Ha-Jun steadies his stance; white healing steam hisses from his ribs as fractured bone instantly knits back together.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Regeneration... turant kaam kar raha hai!

panels.action: The beast unhinges its three-jawed maw: A spinning vortex of black and red gravitational void energy gathers in its throat.
Kuro: 'DHAYAN SE! VOID CANNON HAI! Agar wo campus par gira, toh saikdo masoom maare jayenge!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Roko use! Wo poori building ko uda dega!

panels.action: Behind classroom windows, dozens of terrified students and teachers watch in breathless prayer.

dialogue.text: In sabki jaan ab uske haathon mein thi.

panels.action: Ha-Jun stands his ground, eyes burning like twin purple stars: 'Maine vaada kiya tha... main dubara nahi bhaagunga!'
Ha-Jun draws his right arm back; crystalline spikes erupt along the gauntlet as swirling violet-magenta hellfire engulfs his entire frame.
The beast unleashes the Void Cannon: A massive 10-foot beam of pitch-black destructive antimatter tears across the cobblestones.
Ha-Jun sprints directly into the path of the beam, fist cocked back, completely devoid of fear.

panels.shot: splitting the void beam in two
panels.action: Ha-Jun's crystalline gauntlet punches straight into the void beam, parting the black energy cleanly in two like Moses parting the sea.
Ha-Jun's fist drives clean through the beast's armored forehead, detonating in a blinding flash of pure violet mana.
A majestic dome of violet light engulfs the courtyard, blowing away storm clouds and revealing glimpses of blue sky.
The 15-foot beast crumbles into glittering purple ash, drifting harmlessly onto the wet grass.
A glowing fist-sized violet core hovers and fuses into Ha-Jun's hand: [SYNCHRONIZATION ADVANCED: 8.5%].
Min-Jae sits among the rubble, adjusting his glasses in total stupefaction: 'Ha-Jun... tum... tum aakhir kya ho...?'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun... tumne abhi... ek monster ko maar diya...?

panels.action: Ha-Jun stands in the smoking crater, his gauntlet dissolving into his arm as his eyes return to dark brown: 'Min-Jae... kisi ko mat batana.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Min-Jae... yeh baat hum dono ke beech rahegi.
